name: Sheet (iOS)
summary: A modal panel that slides up over the current screen for a focused task, with a grabber, Cancel and Done. It can rest at a medium height before expanding.

anatomy.purpose: Small bar that hints the sheet can be dragged.
Cancel on the left, title in the middle, Done on the right.
The task: a form, list or detail.

variants.name: Medium detent
variants.use: Quick tasks, the page behind stays visible.

whenToUse: A short, self-contained task such as editing or sharing.
whenNotToUse: A list of actions: use an action sheet.

keyboard: Focus stays inside while it is open.
accessibility.focus: Focus moves to the sheet and returns to the trigger.
notes: Provide a visible close path, not only a drag.
Respect reduced motion for the slide.
